integrity: All-degree theorem proved by representation orthogonality, quaternion geometry, six-residue exact inequalities and group averaging. Finite independent symmetric-power calculations supplement but do not substitute for infinite-degree reasoning.
scientific_limitations: Single integer Wigner degree at a time, the two specified six-element cubic rotation classes, bi-invariant principal-angle geometry and central two-point kernels. Does not prove uniqueness of a function from six scalar samples or universality among all six-point rotation designs. Historical priority beyond accessible comparisons is unresolved; independent validation not performed.
title: Noncongruent octahedral rotation classes with identical Wigner sampling spectra
